title: Flat base change of global sections over an affine base (Stacks 02KH, degree 0)
statement: Let $S$ and $S'$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:S'\to S$ a flat morphism [def-weil-flat-morphism], and $f:X\to S$ a morphism of schemes such that the scheme $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $X'=X\times_SS'$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$. Then the ring map $$\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\otimes_{\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)}\Gamma(S',\mathcal O_{S'})\longrightarrow\Gamma(X',\mathcal O_{X'}),\qquad a\otimes s'\mapsto g'^\sharp(a)\cdot f'^\sharp(s'),$$ where $g'^\sharp,f'^\sharp$ are the maps on global sections and the tensor product is formed through $f^\sharp$ and $g^\sharp$, is an isomorphism.
